answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique hotel loyalty nights. It works because nights stayed at one chain across continents, and the knoll it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Fakes fail here because nights stayed at one chain across continents is tied to something outside the network; the whisper of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the anchor is that the farm's unit economics never work.
